automation_evidence.quote: We propose TSQAGENT, an agentic reasoning framework that integrates reasoning-driven dimension selection and tool-augmented quantitative analysis to address the core challenges of TS quality

metric_evidence.quote: In long-term forecasting, it attains the lowest RMSE in the majority of cases,

evidence.quote: Quantitative Comparison Accuracy. Figure 2b reports the performance of models with and without tool access for quality comparison.

practical_problems.note: TSQBench injects controlled degradations (missing values, noise, etc.) into paired series; with vs without tools and dimension selection are measured per dimension, plus a quality-dimension-group ablation on downstream RMSE

summary: A tool-grounded agent rates time series quality to select training data; on a controlled synthetic benchmark with injected degradations, tools raise comparison accuracy and GRPO raises dimension identification, and selected data lowers forecasting RMSE on real datasets.
